item.title: Oakley Methodist Church — 160th anniversary celebration service
item.description: Morning service followed by coffee/tea and birthday cake.

item.title: Oakley Methodist Church — 160th anniversary open displays
item.description:
Displays by weekday groups using the chapel, heritage photos/items, light refreshments (donation toward charity).

Same weekend as the village Garden Stall trail — stop in if you’re out and about Saturday.

item.title: Coffee Morning
item.description: £1.50 bottomless tea/coffee; charity Dementia UK; woodland wellbeing walkers welcome.

item.title: Coffee Morning
item.description: £1.50 bottomless tea or coffee and biscuits. Charity of the year: Dementia UK. Woodland wellbeing walkers welcome at the end of their walk.

item.title: Coffee Morning
item.description:
Coffee morning with bottomless tea or coffee and biscuits for £1.50. Located on Hill Road by the pond.

Charity of the year is Dementia UK. We welcome Woodland wellbeing walkers at the end of their walk.

Come and join us for a warm drink and friendly conversation in our welcoming community space.
